name: SarCase
description: A Data Subject Access Request case under UK GDPR Article 15. Tracks the full lifecycle from receipt to response delivery. Owned by SVC-015 (Compliance Core, CAP-005). Retains all metadata required for ICO audit and potential enforcement defence.

fields.name: sar_case_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this SAR case

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: FK to subject of the SAR

fields.name: received_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp of receipt — 30-day clock starts here

fields.name: extended_deadline_date
fields.description: Extended deadline if 2-month extension invoked (UK GDPR Article 12(3) complex)

fields.name: extension_reason
fields.description: Justification for extension — required for ICO audit

fields.name: data_sources_queried
fields.description: List of services queried for data extraction

fields.name: redaction_log_ref
fields.description: Reference to redaction log document for audit trail

fields.name: response_pack_ref
fields.description: Encrypted storage reference for compiled response pack

fields.name: response_download_link
fields.description: Secure one-time download URL — expires after 14 days

fields.name: dispatched_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when response was dispatched to customer

fields.name: closed_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when case was closed

fields.name: assigned_officer_id
fields.description: FK to PER-052 Compliance Officer handling this case

fields.name: days_to_close
fields.description: Computed: days from received_at to closed_at for SLA reporting

relationships.description: References the customer (PER-001) who is the subject of the SAR

design_decisions: SarCase owned by SVC-015 (Compliance Core, CAP-005). This is consistent with the CDD review case (ENT-063) and compliance-led case pattern.
redaction_log_ref and response_pack_ref are storage references, not stored binaries — binaries held in a secure document store.
